title: Lumen HR onboarding
supportedQuestion: What fields are required in Lumen's WELCOME-01 exercise template, and where is the resource directory?
supportedFact: WELCOME-01 requires Role / First-day plan / Resource links / Questions. Its resource directory is People Sandbox / Resources.
missingQuestion: How many paid leave days does Lumen provide?
